name: merchant
description: Open-source commerce backend. Bring Stripe key, start selling.

scripts.gen:openapi: bash -c 'source ../../.env && wrangler dev --port 8787 & PID=$! && for i in $(seq 1 30); do sleep 1 && curl -sf http://localhost:8787/openapi.json > ../../openapi.json && echo "\n✓ Generated openapi.json" && kill $PID && exit 0; done; echo "\n✗ wrangler did not respond" && kill $PID && exit 1'
scripts.db:reset: echo 'merchant must be cleaned with rm -rf .wrangler and started' && source ../../.env  && npm run db:init && npm run db:seed
scripts.ai:kv:put: wrangler kv key put ai:config --binding KV_CACHE --path ../../ai.json.enc
